subject_description: an adult red bob-haired swordswoman wearing a crimson long military coat over black plate armor and black armored boots, holding one silver straight longsword
initial_pose: standing in a grounded wide ready stance, one longsword held diagonally down across the front of her legs
description: A disciplined swordswoman activates a defensive frontline stance. She braces both boots, lowers her hips, brings her one straight longsword up in front of her chest with both hands, then holds the blade diagonally as a firm guard and turns her gaze toward an enemy to the right. Her coat tails follow with restrained secondary motion. After a deliberate hold she returns smoothly to the starting ready stance. This is a protection and taunt skill, not an attack: no slash, no running, no jumping, no spinning. Keep the full body and sword visible, camera fixed, same character identity and outfit, no new equipment. Character body motion only; spell effects are composited separately.
